items.raw_excerpt: After losing his teaching job, Colin Lau reshaped his life by buying a flat outright and reducing his spending to a minimum. CNA’s Money Mind unpacks his financial choices, sparking a debate about money, happiness and security.
items.summary_en: Colin Lau lost his teaching job, so he rebuilt his life. He bought a flat with his savings and cut his spending to a minimum. Now he is retired at 35 and no longer fears being fired.
items.summary_ko: 콜린 라우는 교사 일자리를 잃은 뒤 삶을 다시 만들었습니다. 그는 아파트를 한 번에 사고 지출을 최소한으로 줄였습니다. 이제 35살에 은퇴해서 해고를 두려워하지 않는다고 합니다.
items.title_en: A 3-room flat helped this Singaporean retire at 35

items.title_original: How a 3-room flat helped this Singaporean to retire at 35 and stop fearing retrenchment

items.raw_excerpt: From Newcastle in NSW to Windsor Castle in England, Christopher and Miriam Allan carry their family’s love of music across generations and continents.
items.summary_en: Christopher and Miriam Allan are a father and daughter singing duo from Newcastle, Australia. Their love of music has taken them from New South Wales to Windsor Castle in England. Their family has carried music across generations and continents.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite the Saskatoon Exhibition's recent decision to stop featuring spudnuts, a popular potato-based doughnut, the treat remains a beloved staple among enthusiasts.
items.summary_en: The Saskatoon Exhibition has decided to stop selling spudnuts, a popular potato-based doughnut. The treat is still loved and remains a favorite among its fans.

items.raw_excerpt: Associação instala monitorização diária do ar em Fortes, no Alentejo, para denunciar suspeita de poluição industrial e enviar dados às autoridades.
items.summary_en: A local association set up daily air monitoring in Fortes, a small village in Alentejo, Portugal. It wants to show suspected pollution from a nearby factory and send the data to authorities.

items.summary_en: Naomi Osaka hopes her strong play last year in Montreal, where she reached the final, will help her at the WTA 1000 event in Toronto. She is coming off a semifinal run at the Washington tournament.

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland Transport has apologised after a passenger was denied a bus ride with an unmuzzled disability assist dog three years ago.
items.summary_en: Auckland Transport has apologised. Three years ago, a passenger was denied a bus ride with an unmuzzled disability assist dog. The agency said sorry after the case was reviewed.

items.raw_excerpt: Ontario is home to no shortage of incredible lake destinations, and one of its most impressive bodies of water isn't actually a lake at all.
items.summary_en: Georgian Bay is one of Ontario's most beautiful bodies of water. It is called the 'sixth great lake' even though it is not officially a lake. It offers crystal-clear water beaches and charming small towns for a summer getaway.

items.title_en: Ontario has a 'sixth great lake' with clear-water beaches and pretty small towns

items.summary_en: Mount Victoria sits about 1,052 metres above sea level in the Blue Mountains. It has cute cafés and beautiful hiking trails. It is a great winter trip about two hours from Sydney.
